Suspend 4—{U} (Rather than cast this card from your hand, pay {U} and exile it with four time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.)
Target player draws three cards.
entries.chinese:
延缓4～{U} (支付{U}并将此牌放逐且其上有四个计时指示物，而非从你手上施放之。在你的维持开始时，从其上移去一个计时指示物。当移去最后一个时，你可以施放它且不需支付其法术力费用。)
目标牌手抓三张牌。

entries.english:
Draw a card.
Beam me up {2}{U} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for {2}{U} if you also return a creature you control to its owner's hand. Then exile this spell.)
entries.chinese:
抓一张牌。
传送我{2}{U} (如果你同时将一个由你操控的生物移回其拥有者手上，则你可以支付{2}{U}来从你的坟墓场施放此牌。然后放逐此咒语。)
